image_description: A close-up shot of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on the edge of a white bird feeder. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head, orange-rufous breast, and black back with white shoulder patches. It is facing right, with its conical bill visible. The background consists of blurred winter branches.
